scope: Owner-scoped server search across transaction history, combinable with event kind and timezone-aware date filters
searchFields: Event kind and exact decimal-string IDR amount
safetyAndLimits: The authenticated Neon subject is the only tenant selector; the browser cannot provide an owner ID.
Search terms are trimmed and limited to 1-80 characters; SQL uses literal substring matching, not wildcard interpolation.
Search, kind, date range, and cursor are applied in one database read model before pagination.
All amounts remain decimal text; transaction search never converts money to JavaScript numbers.

checks: authenticated provider JWT reaches fixed search RPC
empty and oversized terms rejected before Data API access

security.limitation: Heuristic artifact scan; not a staging auth/RLS audit.
